name: Aqua Romance
source:
"Are you shy? Then how will you do it on the first night?"

They live in the palace of deep sea, where no one know!
Unfold the secrets of those men in the dangerous yet tempting underwater!

In front of the hidden secrets of the sea, can you forge your destiny and protect your connections?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.c5client]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
“这就害羞了吗？那到了初夜，你又该如何应对呢？”

他们居住在无人知晓的深海宫殿之中！
在这危机四伏却又充满诱惑的海底世界，揭开那些男人们隐藏的秘密吧！

面对深海埋藏的重重秘辛，你能否亲手开创命运，守护彼此之间的羁绊？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.storytaco.c5client]Google Play[/url]]
